text_en: When Isaac was old and his eyes were dim so that he could not see, he called his elder son Esau and said to him, “My son”; and he answered, “Here I am. ”
text_cn: 依撒格年纪已老，双目失明，看不见了，遂叫了他的大儿厄撒乌来，对他说：“我儿！”他回答说：“我在这里。”

text_en: He said, “See, I am old; I do not know the day of my death.
text_cn: 他说：“你看，我已年老，不知道哪天就死。

text_en: Now then, take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and hunt game for me.
text_cn: 现在，你拿器械、箭囊和弓，往田间去打点猎物，

text_en: Then prepare for me savory food, such as I like, and bring it to me to eat, so that I may bless you before I die. ”
text_cn: 照我的嗜好给我作成美味，拿来给我吃，好叫我在未死以前祝福你。”

text_en: Now Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to his son Esau. So when Esau went to the field to hunt for game and bring it,
text_cn: 依撒格对他的儿子厄撒乌说这话时，黎贝加听见了。厄撒乌就到田间去给父亲打猎，

text_en: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “I heard your father say to your brother Esau,
text_cn: 黎贝加对自己的儿子雅各伯说：“我听见你父亲对你哥哥厄撒乌说：

text_en: ‘Bring me game, and prepare for me savory food to eat, that I may bless you before the Lord before I die. ’
text_cn: ‘你去给我打点猎物来，作成美味，叫我吃了，好在死前当着上主的面祝福你。’

text_en: Now therefore, my son, obey my word as I command you.
text_cn: 现在，我儿，要听从我吩咐你的话。

text_en: Go to the flock, and get me two choice kids, so that I may prepare from them savory food for your father, such as he likes;
text_cn: 到羊群里去，给我拿两只肥美的小山羊来，我要照你父亲的嗜好，给他作成美味，

text_en: and you shall take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies. ”
text_cn: 你端给父亲吃，好叫他死前祝福你。”

text_en: But Jacob said to his mother Rebekah, “Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, and I am a man of smooth skin.
text_cn: 雅各伯对母亲黎贝加说：“但是我哥哥浑身是毛，我却皮肤光滑，

text_en: Perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall seem to be mocking him, and bring a curse on myself and not a blessing. ”
text_cn: 万一我父亲摸我，必以为我哄骗他，我必招来咒骂，而不是祝福。”

text_en: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son; only obey my word, and go, get them for me. ”
text_cn: 母亲对他说：“我儿，咒骂归于我，你只管听我的话，去给我拿来。”

text_en: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother; and his mother prepared savory food, such as his father loved.
text_cn: 他遂拿了来，交给了他的母亲，他母亲就照他父亲的嗜好作成了美味。

text_en: Then Rebekah took the best garments of her elder son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob;
text_cn: 黎贝加又将家中所存的大儿厄撒乌最好的衣服，给她小儿雅各伯穿上；

text_en: and she put the skins of the kids on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
text_cn: 又用小山羊的皮，包在他的手上和他光滑的颈上，

text_en: Then she handed the savory food, and the bread that she had prepared, to her son Jacob.
text_cn: 然后将自己作好的美味和饼，放在他儿子雅各伯的手里。

text_en: So he went in to his father, and said, “My father”; and he said, “Here I am; who are you, my son? ”
text_cn: 雅各伯来到他父亲前说：“我父！”他答说：“我在这里！我儿，你是谁？”

text_en: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me; now sit up and eat of my game, so that you may bless me. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯对父亲说：“我是你长子厄撒乌。我已照你吩咐的作了。请坐起来，吃我作的野味，好祝福我。”

text_en: But Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son? ” He answered, “Because the Lord your God granted me success. ”
text_cn: 依撒格对他儿子说：“我儿！你怎么这样快就找着了？”雅各伯答说：“因为上主你的天主使我碰得好。”

text_en: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Come near, that I may feel you, my son, to know whether you are really my son Esau or not. ”
text_cn: 依撒格对雅各伯说：“我儿！你前来，让我摸摸，看你是不是我儿厄撒乌？”

text_en: So Jacob went up to his father Isaac, who felt him and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯就走近他父亲依撒格前；依撒格摸着他说：“声音是雅各伯的声音，手却是厄撒乌的手。”

text_en: He did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau’s hands; so he blessed him.
text_cn: 依撒格没有分辨出来，因为他的手，像他哥哥厄撒乌的手一样有毛，就祝福了他。

text_en: He said, “Are you really my son Esau? ” He answered, “I am. ”
text_cn: 随后说：“你真是我儿厄撒乌吗？”雅各伯答说：“我是。”

text_en: Then he said, “Bring it to me, that I may eat of my son’s game and bless you. ” So he brought it to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.
text_cn: 依撒格说：“我儿！递给我，叫我吃了你作的野味，好祝福你。”雅各伯于是递过去，他吃了；又给他拿了酒来，他也喝了。

text_en: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Come near and kiss me, my son. ”
text_cn: 他父亲依撒格就对他说：“我儿！你前来吻我。”

text_en: So he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his garments, and blessed him, and said, “Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed.
text_cn: 他就前去吻了父亲。他父亲一闻到他衣服上的香气，就祝福他说：“看！我儿子的香气，像上主祝福的肥田的香气。

text_en: May God give you of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and wine.
text_cn: 惟愿天主赐与你天上的甘露，土地的肥沃，五谷美酒的丰裕！

text_en: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you, and blessed be everyone who blesses you! ”
text_cn: 愿众民服事你，万国叩拜你！愿你作你兄弟的主人，你母亲的儿子叩拜你！凡诅咒你的，必受诅咒；凡祝福你的，必受祝福。”

text_en: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, when Jacob had scarcely gone out from the presence of his father Isaac, his brother Esau came in from his hunting.
text_cn: 依撒格一祝福了雅各伯，雅各伯刚由他父亲依撒格面前出来，他哥哥厄撒乌打猎回来了。

text_en: He also prepared savory food, and brought it to his father. And he said to his father, “Let my father sit up and eat of his son’s game, so that you may bless me. ”
text_cn: 他也作了美味，给他父亲端来，对他父亲说：“我父！请起来，吃你儿预备的野味，好祝福我。”

text_en: His father Isaac said to him, “Who are you? ” He answered, “I am your firstborn son, Esau. ”
text_cn: 他父亲依撒格对他说：“你是谁？”他答说：“我是你儿，你长子厄撒乌。”

text_en: Then Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who was it then that hunted game and brought it to me, and I ate it all before you came, and I have blessed him? —yes, and blessed he shall be! ”
text_cn: 依撒格不禁战栗起来，惊问说：“那么，是谁打了猎物给我送了来？并且在你未来以前，我已吃了，已祝福了他；他从此必蒙祝福。”

text_en: When Esau heard his father’s words, he cried out with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, me also, father! ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌一听见他父亲说出这话，就放声哀号，对他父亲说：“我父，请你也祝福我！”

text_en: But he said, “Your brother came deceitfully, and he has taken away your blessing. ”
text_cn: 父亲答说：“你弟弟用诡计来夺去了你的祝福。”

text_en: Esau said, “Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright; and look, now he has taken away my blessing. ” Then he said, “Have you not reserved a blessing for me? ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌说：“他不是名叫雅各伯吗？他已两次欺骗了我：以前夺去了我长子的名分，现在又夺去了我的祝福。”继而问说：“你没有给我留下祝福吗？”

text_en: Isaac answered Esau, “I have already made him your lord, and I have given him all his brothers as servants, and with grain and wine I have sustained him. What then can I do for you, my son? ”
text_cn: 依撒格回答厄撒乌说：“看，我已立他作你的主人，将所有的兄弟都给他作仆人，将五谷美酒都供给他了。我儿，我还能为你作什么？”

text_en: Esau said to his father, “Have you only one blessing, father? Bless me, me also, father! ” And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.
text_cn: 厄撒乌对父亲说：“我父，你只有一个祝福吗？我父，你也得祝福我。”厄撒乌就放声大哭。

text_en: Then his father Isaac answered him: “See, away from the fatness of the earth shall your home be, and away from the dew of heaven on high.
text_cn: 他父亲依撒格回答他说：“看，你住的地方必缺乏肥沃的土地，天上的甘露。

text_en: By your sword you shall live, and you shall serve your brother; but when you break loose, you shall break his yoke from your neck. ”
text_cn: 你要凭仗刀剑生活，要服事你的弟弟；但你一强盛起来，将由你的颈上，摆脱他的束缚。”

text_en: Now Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him, and Esau said to himself, “The days of mourning for my father are approaching; then I will kill my brother Jacob. ”
text_cn: 厄撒乌因为他父亲祝福了雅各伯，便怀恨雅各伯，心下思念说：“为父亲居丧的日期已近，到时我必要杀死我弟弟雅各伯。”

text_en: But the words of her elder son Esau were told to Rebekah; so she sent and called her younger son Jacob and said to him, “Your brother Esau is consoling himself by planning to kill you.
text_cn: 有人告诉了黎贝加她大儿厄撒乌所说的话；她便派人叫了她小儿雅各伯来，对他说：“看，你哥哥厄撒乌想要杀你泄恨。

text_en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran,
text_cn: 现在，我儿！你得听我的话，起身逃往哈兰我哥哥拉班那里去，

text_en: and stay with him a while, until your brother’s fury turns away—
text_cn: 与他住些时日，直到你哥哥忿怒消失了。

text_en: until your brother’s anger against you turns away, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send, and bring you back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day? ”
text_cn: 几时你哥哥对你息了怒，忘了你对他作的事，我就派人去，从那里接你回来。为什么我在一日内要丧失你们两个呢？”

text_en: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the Hittite women. If Jacob marries one of the Hittite women such as these, one of the women of the land, what good will my life be to me? ”
text_cn: 黎贝加就对依撒格说：“为了这两个赫特女人，我厌恶得要死；假使雅各伯也从这地的女人中娶一个像这样的赫特女人为妻，我还活着做什么？”
